SELECT g.order_id, g.order_no, g.order_type, g.brand, g.status, g.merch_id, g.style_id, s.code AS style_code, s.name AS style_name, g.qty, g.scheduled_qty, g.returned_qty, g.due_date, CASE WHEN g.short_returned THEN g.due_date - #{today} END AS days_left, f.late AS risk_late, f.near AS risk_near, f.unscheduled AS risk_unscheduled, pr.node_late AS risk_node_late, pr.issue AS risk_issue, (pr.node_late OR pr.issue OR pr.due_soon) AS risk_production
AND f.unscheduled AND f.near AND f.late AND (pr.node_late OR pr.issue OR pr.due_soon)
ORDER BY (CASE WHEN f.late THEN 8 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN pr.node_late THEN 4 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN pr.issue THEN 2 ELSE 0 END) + (CASE WHEN f.near THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, g.due_date, g.order_no, s.code

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.unscheduled) AS unscheduled, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.near) AS near, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE f.late) AS late, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE pr.node_late OR pr.issue OR pr.due_soon) AS production
